zh.title: 航空業高層稱駕駛艙內部威脅難以完全防範
zh.summary: 瑞安航空集團與漢莎航空高層表示，嚴格篩檢仍無法完全防範駕駛艙內部威脅
body: 瑞安航空集團執行長 Michael O’Leary 在布魯塞爾舉行的 Airlines for Europe 記者會上表示，若駕駛艙內有人意圖造成傷害，立法很難完全防範。他說：「如果駕駛艙裡有人行為失常，要透過立法來防範非常困難。」
報導指出，O’Leary 與漢莎航空執行長 Carsten Spohr 均承認，即使嚴格篩檢，也無法保證能防範意圖傷害他人的飛行員。O’Leary 另表示，航空業不存在絕對的安全與保安；他同時認為，現行飛行員心理健康篩檢制度仍相當健全。

en.title: Airline chiefs say screening cannot fully prevent cockpit insider threats
en.summary: Ryanair Group and Lufthansa chiefs say screening cannot fully prevent cockpit insider threats.
body: Ryanair Group chief executive Michael O’Leary told reporters at an Airlines for Europe press conference in Brussels that legislation has limits when someone in the cockpit intends harm. “If you have somebody who is a mad person in a cockpit, it’s very difficult to legislate for it,” he said.

The report says O’Leary and Lufthansa chief executive Carsten Spohr acknowledged that even rigorous screening cannot guarantee protection against a pilot determined to cause harm. O’Leary also said there was “no absolute safety and security in this industry,” while maintaining that existing mental health screening of pilots was robust.
